local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local InventoryUpdate = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("InventoryUpdate")
local label = script.Parent:WaitForChild("LabelMadeira")

InventoryUpdate.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(action, data)
	if action == "Update" then
		label.Text = "Madeira: " .. (data.Madeira or 0)
	end
end)

local tool = game.Workspace:WaitForChild("MadeiraTool")
tool.Activated:Connect(function()
	InventoryUpdate:FireServer("Collect", "Madeira")
end)

properties.Source:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local InventoryUpdate = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("InventoryUpdate")

local playerInventories = {}

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
	playerInventories[player.UserId] = {Madeira = 0}
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	playerInventories[player.UserId] = nil
end)

InventoryUpdate.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, action, item)
	if action == "Collect" and item == "Madeira" then
		-- Validação básica: verificar se a ferramenta existe no inventário do jogador
		local character = player.Character
		if character and character:FindFirstChild("MadeiraTool") then
			playerInventories[player.UserId].Madeira += 1
			InventoryUpdate:FireClient(player, "Update", playerInventories[player.UserId])
		end
	end
end)
